BLAKE-JAB.title: Jab
BLAKE-GUARD.title: Guard
BLAKE-REV_UP.title: Rev Up
BLAKE-HAYMAKER.title: Haymaker
BLAKE-WARM_ENGINE.title: Warm Engine
BLAKE-WIND_UP.title: Wind-Up
BLAKE-RAPTOR_BOOST.title: Raptor Boost
BLAKE-GUARD_UP.title: Guard Up
BLAKE-GUARD_UP.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If your [gold]Charge[/gold] is above base, gain {HighBlock:diff()} instead.
BLAKE-ONE_TWO.title: One-Two
BLAKE-DASH_ATTACK.title: Dash Attack
BLAKE-SHOULDER_CHECK.title: Shoulder Check
BLAKE-SHOULDER_CHECK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Sweetspot[/gold] — enemy intends to Attack: apply {Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
BLAKE-FALCON_DIVE.title: Falcon Dive
BLAKE-FALCON_DIVE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If Fatal, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and [gold]Rev[/gold].
BLAKE-SIDESTEP.title: Sidestep
BLAKE-SHOW_ME_YOUR_MOVES.title: Show Me Your Moves
BLAKE-FULL_THROTTLE.title: Full Throttle
BLAKE-IGNITION.title: Ignition
BLAKE-REDLINE.title: Redline
BLAKE-REDLINE.description:
[gold]Rev[/gold].
If your [gold]Charge[/gold] is {Threshold:diff()} or more, [gold]Rev[/gold] again.
BLAKE-SLIPSTREAM.title: Slipstream
BLAKE-SLIPSTREAM.description: Whenever you play your {Threshold:diff()}th card in a turn, [gold]Rev[/gold].
BLAKE-PERFECT_SHIELD.title: Perfect Shield
BLAKE-PERFECT_SHIELD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you block ALL attack damage this turn, [gold]Rev[/gold] at end of turn.
BLAKE-PRESSURE.title: Pressure
BLAKE-PRESSURE.description:
Deal damage equal to half your [gold]Charge[/gold].
Doesn't reset.
BLAKE-STORED_POWER.title: Stored Power
BLAKE-FALCON_KICK.title: Falcon Kick
BLAKE-FALCON_KICK.description: [gold]Unleash[/gold] — deal damage equal to your [gold]Charge[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BLAKE-CLEAN_KO.title: Clean KO
BLAKE-CLEAN_KO.description:
Deal damage equal to your [gold]Charge[/gold].
If this kills the enemy, don't reset.
BLAKE-KNEE_OF_JUSTICE.title: Knee of Justice
BLAKE-KNEE_OF_JUSTICE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Sweetspot[/gold] — enemy intends to Attack: deal {SweetDamage:diff()} instead.
BLAKE-GRAB.title: Grab
BLAKE-GRAB.description: The target loses ALL [gold]Block[/gold], then deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
BLAKE-SPOT_DODGE.title: Spot Dodge
BLAKE-SPOT_DODGE.description: The next time an enemy attacks you this turn, it misses entirely.
BLAKE-YES.title: YES!
BLAKE-YES.description: If you [gold]Unleashed[/gold] this turn: gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
BLAKE-WARM_UP_LAP.title: Warm-Up Lap
BLAKE-FALCON_PUNCH.title: FALCON PUNCH
BLAKE-FALCON_PUNCH.description:
[gold]Unleash[/gold] — deal damage equal to DOUBLE your [gold]Charge[/gold].
[gold]Follow-Through[/gold] (excess damage hits another enemy).
BLAKE-BLUE_FALCON.title: Blue Falcon
BLAKE-BLUE_FALCON.description:
Deal damage equal to your [gold]Charge[/gold] to ALL enemies.
This doesn't reset your [gold]Charge[/gold].
BLAKE-G_DIFFUSER.title: G-Diffuser
BLAKE-G_DIFFUSER.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Rev[/gold].
BLAKE-SUPER_ARMOR.title: Super Armor
BLAKE-SUPER_ARMOR.description: Your [gold]Charge[/gold] can no longer be halved.
BLAKE-CHAMPIONS_FIST.title: Champion's Fist
BLAKE-MUSCLE_MEMORY.title: Muscle Memory
BLAKE-MUSCLE_MEMORY.description: [gold]Rev[/gold] once, plus once more for each time you've [gold]Unleashed[/gold] this combat.
BLAKE-HIGHLIGHT_REEL.title: Highlight Reel
BLAKE-HIGHLIGHT_REEL.description: Whenever you [gold]Unleash[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
BLAKE-HEAT_HAZE.title: Heat Haze
BLAKE-HEAT_HAZE.description: Whenever you [gold]Rev[/gold], deal {Haze:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
BLAKE-HARD_READ.title: Hard Read
BLAKE-HARD_READ.description:
[gold]Sweetspot[/gold] — if the enemy intends to Attack: it is [gold]Stunned[/gold].
Otherwise, draw 1 card.
BLAKE-PHOTO_FINISH.title: Photo Finish
BLAKE-PHOTO_FINISH.description:
Deal damage equal to your [gold]Charge[/gold].
[gold]Sweetspot[/gold] — this kills the last enemy: heal {Heal:diff()} HP and gain {Gold:diff()} Gold.
